text.T010:
The website interface is English. Publication-language labels use EN for English and UA for
    Ukrainian; machine-readable language codes are en and uk. UA in a project name means Uncertainty
    Architecture. A platform edition is not automatically a translation; unverified talk languages
    are omitted.
text.T012:
Auto uses your device's local time: Day from 07:00 until 19:00, Night otherwise. You can choose
    either theme yourself. Theme and motion preferences are stored locally in your browser; no
    location request, account or analytics is involved. The decorative spatial background follows
    native scrolling on each page, and topic choices in Writing. The thematic structures also move
    gently in a repeating cycle while you read. Motion off freezes both the camera and the
    structures; your reduced-motion preference overrides a saved On choice. Theme changes only
    recolor that view. No measurement or scientific simulation is represented. Without JavaScript,
    your device's light/dark preference and a static geometric background supply the fallback.

text.T022: This website is a practical experiment in AI-assisted software delivery. I direct its architecture, requirements, design decisions and acceptance; AI tools support implementation, analysis and verification.
text.T023: The project explores a question central to my research: how to benefit from faster AI-assisted implementation without losing engineering control, maintainability or accountability.
text.T025: Content and templates are separate from the rendering engine and visual effects. Generated HTML keeps the site readable without JavaScript; navigation and Canvas are enhancements.
text.T030: Work starts with an issue and explicit acceptance criteria, then proceeds through a linked PR, code review and checks. Test results provide evidence; review, merge and release remain human decisions.
text.T035: PR smoke, bounded staging regression and full production regression have distinct profiles. Release checks bind evidence to the exact source and built artifact; staging success does not authorize production.
text.T040: The colored ribbons were removed while retaining the fractal scene, navigation and readable content. This scoped change passed the existing bounded staging checks without relaxing their budgets.
text.T042: This is a personal engineering example of human-directed delivery, with relevance to larger programs. It does not establish enterprise-scale effectiveness, an implementation of Uncertainty Architecture or scientific validation of the research.
